long_biography.plain_text:
At a concert in Liberty State Park, Frank Cretella noticed a rusted riverfront foundation and imagined a restaurant there. He contacted park officials the next day, negotiated a lease and opened Liberty House with his wife, Jeanne, in 2001. The project became the first property in their New Jersey hospitality portfolio.

Cretella developed an operating model around neglected or historic buildings. Landmark Developers acquires and plans properties, while Black Dog Construction handles building work before restaurant, hotel and events teams take over daily operations. That integration gives him control from concept through use and has shaped adaptive-reuse projects across New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
